title: plan_in_model regression fix (5-tuple component unpack) + structured-nav-model live navigation solve of tu93.
not_a_new_solve_claim: tu93 L1 already registered; this validates (a) the plan_in_model regression fix and (b) that a structured InducedNavWorldModel + plan_in_model reaches a real tu93 level-up live. No registry change.

regression.bug: _model_candidates unpacked _components_detailed as a 4-tuple; the field was widened to a 5-tuple (+is_grid_fallback) in commit 2f0760307 -> ValueError on any grid with components -> plan_in_model silently disabled for object-bearing games.
regression.fix: defensive `for cy, cx, _a, _c, *_ in comps` unpack in arc_executable_world_model._model_candidates; docstring on arc_graph_explore._components_detailed corrected to note the 5-tuple + the defensive-unpack requirement.
regression.regression_test: tests/python/test_plan_in_model_component_unpack.py (2 tests; the rigid 4-unpack raises ValueError on a 5-tuple, confirmed).

methodology_note: InducedNavWorldModel.fit derives per-action displacement + avatar + goal from the agent's OWN recon transitions (structured, correct-by-construction for the nav family -- NOT LLM induction). plan_in_model plans in-model (no env), then _execute_plan_measure executes ONCE from a fresh reset and checks the REAL level counter (not a heuristic). No LLM. Public-game frames for offline dev.
sidesteps_nonidempotent_reset: plan_in_model plans in imagination + executes once from reset -> no per-node resets -> the non-idempotent-reset blocker (REQ-ARC-WMTE-5840) does not apply.
headline: REGRESSION FOUND + FIXED: plan_in_model crashed on component-grids since 2f0760307 (5-tuple _components_detailed), silently disabling E3's world-model planner. After the fix, a structured InducedNavWorldModel + plan_in_model reaches a REAL tu93 level-up in 3/3 runs (e.g. 18-action plan, hv 60.125->6.125). plan_in_model plans in imagination + executes once from reset -> sidesteps the non-idempotent-reset blocker -> live-compatible navigation solve.
next_step: InducedNavWorldModel (the structured nav inducer) is currently ORPHANED from the live E3 path (imported only by scripts/tests). The concrete unblock: route navigation games (detected via derive_navigation_pair) to InducedNavWorldModel instead of the LLM induction, and feed its engine+is_level_complete to the live plan_in_model tier -- giving E3 a CORRECT model for nav games instead of the near-universally-wrong LLM one. This is the 'mechanic-class prior' direction the 2026-07-20 diagnosis §6 flagged as highest-leverage.
